text:
diana_pm: Planning precision-rollout for the new latency-aware router. Need compact canary ladder, per-tenant opt-outs, and a clear fallback story. Proposal: shadow -> micro (0.5%) -> regional (5%) -> broad (30%) -> global, with manual gate at 30%.
samir_eng: Sounds good. For safety biasing we'll do 80% control / 20% candidate inside each active pct. Collect 8k eval samples per stage.
lucy_sre: Abort rules: 5xx spike >0.4% for 5m OR p99 latency +80ms for 10m OR GPU/CPU util >88% for 8m -> auto-rollback. Also watch queue depth growth >12% for 10m.
nate_platform: Flag schema: `precision_router_v1` fields: `stage_pct`, `region_allowlist`, `tenant_exempt`, `auto_advance` (bool). I'll expose per-tenant force-off and tenant-audit logs.
samir_eng: Instrumentation checklist: traces include `router.variant`, `router.reason`, `tenant_id`. Emit `router.latency_delta_ms`, `router.cache_miss_pct`, and `router.cost_delta_pct`.
diana_pm: Quality pass: eval regression <=1%, user error delta <=0.25%, cost delta <5%. PM signoff required at 30% before global.
lucy_sre: Add cache-affinity check: pause if cache miss delta >10% sustained for 20m. Also sticky-session drop >0.75% -> pause.
nate_platform: Sample flag YAML:
```yaml
flag: precision_router_v1
stages:
  - name: shadow
    mode: shadow
    duration_min: 120
  - name: micro
    pct: 0.5
    regions: [us-west-2]
    duration_min: 30
  - name: regional
    pct: 5
    regions: [us-west-2, eu-west-1]
    duration_min: 45
  - name: broad
    pct: 30
    regions: [global]
    duration_min: 60
manual_gate_after: 30
abort_conditions: ["5xx>0.4%","p99+80ms","gpu_util>88%","cache_miss+10%"]
```
rollout-bot: Draft flag created: precision_router_v1 by nate_platform. Runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/precision-router (request perms).
diana_pm: Schedule: shadow tonight 23:00 UTC (2h), micro tomorrow 08:00 UTC, regional later same day, broad Thu 14:00 UTC, manual gate Fri 10:00 UTC. Owners: diana_pm (PM), samir_eng (eng), lucy_sre (oncall), nate_platform (flags).
samir_eng: Test plan: unit + e2e, 2h shadow with synthetic load, divergence & cache-warm probes, smoke checks every 5m. Shadow logs to `index=precision-shadow`.
lucy_sre: I'll own oncall for first 48h and prepare rollback play. Pager on abort triggers; slack-only otherwise.
diana_pm: Customer comms: pre-notify CS before 30% gate; if auto-rollback happens message: "We reverted routing to maintain service quality; investigating." Open support ticket for impacted tenants.
nate_platform: Adding `tenant_exempt` defaults for enterprise labels and per-tenant force-off endpoint. Audit logs will capture overrides.
diana_pm: Any other edge cases?
samir_eng: KV-cache warming — add warmup probe for top keys and abort if miss_rate > 9% over 30m.
lucy_sre: Add alert: pager if two abort conditions hit within 15m.
diana_pm: OK, proceeding with shadow tonight. I'll post to #customer-success when we hit the 30% gate. Thanks team :rocket:
